notes: Gold SQL is hand-written independently of the offline planner. 'intent' is what the simulated user picks when asked. 'match_columns' (optional) limits matching to those gold columns.

cases.question: How many new customers signed up last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01' AND created_at < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many orders were placed last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What was our total revenue last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(order_value) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: What was the average order value last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(order_value) AS aov FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: How many orders were canceled last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: Which payment method brought in the most money last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT pm.payment_type, SUM(pm.payment_value) AS total FROM payments pm JOIN orders od USING (order_id) WHERE od.order_status != 'canceled' AND od.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND od.order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY pm.payment_type ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was revenue by category last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT pr.category, SUM(it.quantity * it.unit_price - it.discount) AS revenue FROM order_items it JOIN orders od USING (order_id) JOIN products pr USING (product_id) WHERE od.order_status != 'canceled' AND od.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND od.order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY pr.category

cases.question: How many customers placed at least one order last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND order_date < '2026-10-01') x

cases.question: Show monthly revenue for 2026.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT to_char(order_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, SUM(order_value) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many orders did we get in the last 7 days?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders WHERE order_status != 'canceled' AND order_date >= '2026-10-06' AND order_date < '2026-10-13'

cases.question: What is the total number of customers?

cases.question: Which state has the most customers?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT customer_state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM customers GROUP BY customer_state ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What was the revenue in August 2026?

cases.question: Top 5 customers by total spend last month

cases.question: Which product sold the most units last month?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT pr.product_name, SUM(it.quantity) AS units FROM order_items it JOIN orders od USING (order_id) JOIN products pr USING (product_id) WHERE od.order_status != 'canceled' AND od.order_date >= '2026-09-01' AND od.order_date < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY pr.product_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1
